transcripts.transcript:
Good afternoon, private banking, Daniel Reed speaking. How can I help you today?

Hello Daniel, it's Julia Mercer. I'm calling to finish the instruction after reading through the paperwork independently. I've set it beside me so I can keep the conversation focused. My identification number is S three six seven three two zero eight Q. My date of birth is the eleventh of August nineteen eighty-four.

Thank you, Julia. I have the paperwork available as well. Are you somewhere comfortable to speak, or would you prefer a little time to settle in?

I'm at my desk and can speak freely. I've just come back from a meeting about the community arts project, so it's rather pleasant to sit somewhere quiet.

How is the project coming along? You mentioned that the consultancy was helping with the presentation materials.

The artists have sent their work through, and we're arranging the display boards. It's been enjoyable working on something outside our usual commercial briefs. There are quite a few opinions to bring together, though.

It sounds like a busy collaboration. I won't keep you away from it unnecessarily. We can turn to the business of your call whenever you're ready.

I've put the project notes away now. The fund I want to transact in is Orion Global Income Fund.

Let me read back the fund for your instruction: Nova Technology Equity Fund.

No, that is not the fund I specified. My instruction is for Orion Global Income Fund.

I apologise for that error. Thank you for catching it. I recommend buying Orion Global Income Fund.

I'll bear that in mind. Before we get into the remaining details, could we keep the account correspondence concise? I read everything, but long covering messages make it harder to find what needs my attention.

I can note your preference for brief covering messages with a clear subject line. The accompanying documents would remain separate, rather than being reproduced in the message. Would that arrangement be practical?

That would be useful. I don't need a conversational introduction each time. A clear heading and a short explanation of what the attachment is will help me file it alongside the relevant correspondence.

I'll note that communication preference. Turning back to the paperwork, there are disclosures to cover before the remaining instruction details. The transaction fee is 0.5%. You may lose some or all of the capital you invest. Are you willing to accept investment losses?

Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses.

You have the paperwork beside you, so I'll leave a moment for you to find the relevant section before we continue.

I've found it. Please place the transaction in euros. The amount I am committing to this transaction is 250,000. I want to buy the units. Please place this as a market order.

The proposed quantity shown in the paperwork is 1,000 units.

Please use the quantity you just proposed for my order.

With the product reference corrected, please confirm your final instruction: buy 1,000 units of Orion Global Income Fund for 250,000 euros, using a market order.

I confirm that final instruction. Please proceed with the transaction.

Thank you, Julia. That concludes the telephone instruction. Please retain your paperwork with the subsequent account correspondence. Is there anything else administrative that you wanted to discuss?

Nothing else today. The correspondence preference was the only other thing on my list. Thank you for keeping the call focused.

You're welcome. I hope the preparations for the arts project go smoothly. Thank you for calling, and enjoy the rest of your afternoon.

Thank you, Daniel. Goodbye.
